<translate>
'''Paladin''' is the protector among the [[Special:MyLanguage/Classes|classes]]. It has a high Defense scaling, and its passive takes part of the damage its party members suffer while healing it from the damage they deal.
</translate>

<translate>
== Passive: Guardian ==

While you are in a party (<code>/dmzparty</code>, see [[Special:MyLanguage/Commands|Commands]]):

* '''15%''' of the damage your party members take is redirected to you;
* you heal for '''15%''' of the damage your party members deal.

Only members in the same dimension and within '''50 blocks''' count, and hits smaller than 1% of the target's max health are ignored. The redirected share is reduced by '''your own defense''', never takes you below 1 health (whatever you can't take stays on your ally) and doesn't flash your screen. Your own hits never heal you or get redirected to you.
</translate>

<translate>
== Starting stats and regeneration ==

* '''Starting stats:''' SKP 5 · RES 10 · VIT 5
* '''Regeneration''' (per 5 seconds): health 2.0 (+0.0675 per VIT) · Ki 4.0 (+0.08 per ENE) · stamina 8.0 (+0.03 per VIT, +0.04 per RES)
</translate>

<translate>
== Stat scaling ==

The Paladin's standout scaling is '''Defense''' (DEF 0.336), second only to the Tank. The VIT and DEF values grow on a curve as you invest more, up to 4 times the starting rate. Compare every class on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Classes#Default stat scalings|Classes]] page.
</translate>

<translate>
== Configuration ==
</translate>
{{Config|Custom Races|stats.json}}
<translate>
The class id is <code>paladin</code>. Its passive values are <code>redirectPct</code> (0.15) and <code>lifestealPct</code> (0.15), set per race in <code>races/&lt;race&gt;/stats.json</code> together with the starting stats, scalings and regeneration.
</translate>
